decisions.statement: The build output already written is packed.
An addon with no build output refuses the pack.
Every addon on the roster is packed.
A sibling folder a manifest declares is packed with its addon.
A dependency the roster does not have is reported rather than packed.
Entry timestamps are fixed, so two runs over one build output give the same bytes.
Nothing here says what the archive is named by.

definition: every distributable addon's build output packed into one archive
